pages.text: Draupnir, Odin's ring: every day 8 gold nuggets drip from it. Gungnir, his spear, never misses: right-click strikes the creature you look at within 48 blocks, and the spear is back in your hand.
The dwarf smith forges Draupnir for a fang of Garm, and Gungnir for a fang of Fenrir. The spear also lies in the valkyrie halls.
A valkyrie wife is a chooser of the slain. While she is within 64 blocks a deadly blow does not kill you: she carries you out of the battle. Once a day.
